Container.Name: Odysseus-SearXNG
Container.Overview:
SearXNG metasearch engine, pre-configured as the web-search companion for Odysseus (Deep Research and web search tools).
IMPORTANT — one-time setup: Odysseus talks to SearXNG via its JSON API, which is disabled by default. After the first start, edit settings.yml in this container's appdata folder and make the search formats section read:
search: formats: - html - json
then restart this container. Alternatively copy the ready-made file from the Odysseus repo (config/searxng/settings.yml) into the appdata folder before first start and replace __SEARXNG_SECRET__ with any random string.
Finally set SEARXNG_INSTANCE on the Odysseus container to http://SERVER_IP:8089 (adjust if you changed the port).
The image tag is pinned to a version known to boot cleanly with Odysseus; bump it deliberately.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for SearXNG. Odysseus's SEARXNG_INSTANCE must point at this port.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: SearXNG configuration. Edit settings.yml here to enable the JSON format (see Overview).

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of this SearXNG instance, e.g. http://SERVER_IP:8089/.
